# preprocessing.exog_providers.EntsoeNetLoadProvider { #spotforecast2_safe.preprocessing.exog_providers.EntsoeNetLoadProvider }

```python
preprocessing.exog_providers.EntsoeNetLoadProvider(data_home=None)
```

ENTSO-E day-ahead net load = Forecasted Load − (wind + solar) forecast.

Combines the day-ahead Forecasted Load with the day-ahead renewable
forecast to form the net-load prior the residual is often modelled against.
Both inputs are day-ahead (leakage-clean). Raises
:class:`ExogProviderError` if either input is unavailable.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                                   | Description                                   | Default   |
|-----------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|-----------|
| data_home | [DataHome](`spotforecast2_safe.preprocessing.exog_providers.DataHome`) | Root data directory forwarded to the loaders. | `None`    |
